claims.text: Natamycin is the drug of choice for filamentous fungi (eg, Fusarium); amphotericin B for yeast (eg, Candida); voriconazole is broadest but less effective
claims.quote: Fungal infections are treated with topical antifungal drops, such as natamycin (the medication of choice for filamentous fungus, eg, Fusarium), amphotericin B (the medication of choice for yeast, eg, Candida), or sometimes voriconazole (which is less effective but has the broadest spectrum).

claims.text: Deep infection may need oral voriconazole, ketoconazole, fluconazole or itraconazole added
claims.quote: Deep infections may require addition of oral voriconazole, ketoconazole, fluconazole, or itraconazole.
